subject.title: fix(codex): heartbeat notifications to other channels are silently denied by cross-context policy

question: Should heartbeat, cron, and inter-session Codex turns carrying the synthetic WebChat marker be authorized as unbound and therefore allowed to send across providers under the default policy?
rationale: Source and proof support the classifier, but only maintainers can confirm that restoring pre-v2026.6.9 delivery is the intended authorization boundary rather than requiring an explicit cross-context configuration override.

options.title: Approve the scoped exemption
options.body: Treat only synthetic internal-channel heartbeat, cron, and inter-session turns as unbound while preserving containment for genuine conversations and real delivery channels.

options.title: Keep default fail-closed behavior
options.body: Reject the exemption and require operators to explicitly enable cross-provider sends for autonomous notification workflows.

options.title: Model autonomy in core policy
options.body: Replace the Codex-local exception with a generic typed autonomous-turn authorization fact shared by all runtimes before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped exemption
recommendation.body: Treat only synthetic internal-channel heartbeat, cron, and inter-session turns as unbound while preserving containment for genuine conversations and real delivery channels.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to the affected Codex app-server dynamic-tool and run-attempt ownership boundary.
